name: lima
title: Lima
description: Start, stop and open your Lima virtual machines, create them from templates, and run your own lima.yaml manifests, in a keyboard-first split view.
author: gibranbadrul

commands.name: instances
commands.title: Instances
commands.subtitle: Lima
commands.description: See your Lima instances, start or stop them and open a shell.

commands.name: create-instance
commands.title: Create Instance
commands.subtitle: Lima
commands.description: Create a Lima instance from one of Lima's templates. Type the name right in root search.

commands.name: run-manifest
commands.title: Run Manifest
commands.subtitle: Lima
commands.description: Run your own lima.yaml files from one folder, and see the instance each one made.

commands.name: image-cache
commands.title: Image Cache
commands.subtitle: Lima
commands.description: See the disk images Lima downloaded, which instances use them, and free the space they take.

commands.name: volumes
commands.title: Volumes
commands.subtitle: Lima
commands.description: See the Lima disks there are, which instances use them and the space they take, and delete the ones you don't need.

preferences.name: limactlPath
preferences.title: limactl Path
preferences.description: Where limactl is, if Lima can't find it on your shell's PATH. Like /opt/homebrew/bin/limactl.

preferences.name: manifestsFolder
preferences.title: Manifests Folder
preferences.description: Where your own lima.yaml files are. Run Manifest lists them; each makes an instance named after the file.

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: The app Open Shell runs limactl shell in.
